notes: The bracketed [הַ] assimilated into בַּיּוֹם is a real token and takes the single written the (rule 12); the ordinal's agreement article is the unrepresented one, since the phrase's one the stands at the left edge the first article opens (rule 47).

בְּשַׂר עָרְלָתוֹ is split as construct with a supplied the, rectum with of, and suffix with his (rules 29, 19, 18), and the Niphal verb carries its passive auxiliaries headed on circumcised (rule 24).
